freeze_proof: The first Git commit containing this file. This is prospective registration, not proof that historical data were unseen.
signal: Previous completed month NIFTY 50 price close strictly below arithmetic mean of the latest 10 consecutive completed monthly closes; equality is risk-on.
target: max(0, baseline equity percent - 20) in risk-off, otherwise baseline. No valuation damping. No increase above baseline.
historical_scope: Legacy V3.6 valuation-core screen only; full historical macro and earnings are unavailable. Not a V3.10 historical strategy test.
historical_execution: Use inputs strictly before calendar 1st; execute at first shared NIFTY TRI/debt-index close on or after that date; hold to the next monthly execution close. Never trade at the already-observed signal close.
prospective_entry: First eligible as-observed packet in each month, frozen once. Earliest execution is a trading close strictly after the India calendar date of first observation. No backdated entry.
band_definition: Compare target with drifted actual equity weight at the rebalance time, not the previous target. Trade to target only when absolute difference is greater than the band.
debt_basis: NIFTY 10 YR BENCHMARK G-SEC total-return index. Long-duration sensitivity, not a liquid-fund substitute. No fabricated debt returns for unavailable dates.

cashflow_assumptions.flow_timing: Contribution or pro-rata withdrawal at monthly execution close before rebalance; no claim of tax-optimal funding

tax_status: Not modelled in v1; results are after assumed trading/fund costs but before tax. Historical tax/instrument modelling remains a separate gate.
primary_metric: Maximum daily portfolio drawdown for the no-external-cashflow comparison
benchmarks: Static equity exposure matched to realized challenger average; ex-post attribution diagnostic, not implementable prospective benchmark

promotion_requirements.required: Also assess exposure-matched benchmark, expected shortfall, after-tax implementation and serial-dependence/multiple-testing-corrected uncertainty. Thresholds permit review only, not automatic acceptance.

statistics: No DSR/PBO/White-test value will be invented from unknown trial counts or the rejected harness. Historical runs are exploratory; prospective decisions are preserved.
